Verification counts describe concrete checked cases, not universal accuracy percentages.

Coverage limits

The simulators are bounded teaching implementations, not arbitrary C interpreters. Counts are under explicitly stated sequencing and arithmetic conventions. No chapter guarantees a score on every unseen question. External image-only examples and complete third-party exercise collections are not represented as fully reproduced. Only the checked Q167 option/explanation discrepancy was corrected in six earlier adaptations. All content outside that question is independently compared with the previous commit.
